name: CRT news graphic insert

generation_params.prompt:
Create ONE single cinematic16:9 still frame, requested3840x2160, high detail. This is a clean animation start frame, not a contact sheet, grid, storyboard page, split screen or sequence. Use tactile cinematic3D cyberpunk animation: readable fur and fabrics, weathered metal/brick/concrete, restrained cyan/magenta practical light and warm amber lamps, plausible optics and shadows. Keep the supplied established world and physical designs. No title, panel label, shot ID, subtitles, dialogue, timestamp, watermark or production annotation is burned into the image. One natural held pose at the beginning of the described beat; do not try to show a whole shot’s duration or multiple actions in one image. Any dialogue supplied separately is performance context only and must never appear as words in the picture. Use only the specified visible cast; realistic feline/canine paws, no human fingers, extra limbs, merged bodies, duplicate faces or borrowed accessories. Reference sheets provide identity/material evidence only: never copy their panel layout, text or labels into this single frame. Front CRT insert using the SAME rusted housing and two FRAME-RIGHT knobs. The interruption has settled: screen is a clean dark corporate-blue compositing field with a restrained red/gold edge-light treatment inspired by WOOF7. Leave its main picture and lower third clear for final WOOF7/Goodboy Global overlay. No visible anchor or extra television inside this television; no captions or fake emergency details. 

REFERENCE SCOPE AND HARD CONTINUITY: Image 1 fixes the existing television position and room light. Image 2 is the same rusty two-knob CRT master, Image 3 the CatStation 5 ABOVE it. Only render one close-up television, not the sheets or their labels. Screen must have NO words, logos, numbers, humans, cats or dogs. Keep the requested interference/compositing-screen state; no old broadcast image is supplied or required. Existing stickers on the television housing remain physical stickers.
